# Appendix C: Command-line reference {#app-cli}

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_cli.py. Do not edit. -->

All 95 options of the pinned compiler, from the table that also drives `tiko --help`.

Environment variables

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `TIKO_CLANG` | Full path to `clang`. Without it tiko looks at `C:\Program Files\LLVM\bin\clang.exe` on Windows, `/usr/bin/clang` on Linux or Homebrew's `/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang` on macOS, and searches `PATH` only when that file is absent. `llvm-ar` and `llvm-rc` are taken from the same directory. |
| `TIKO_INCLUDE` | Replaces the default include directory (`<exe>/inc`). `-i` paths are searched first either way. |
| `TIKO_LIBPATH` | Replaces the bundled library directory (`<exe>/lib/<target>`). `-p` paths and `#libpath` are searched first either way. |

Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | errors in the program |
| 2 | command-line error |
| 3 | no usable toolchain (clang not found) |
| 4 | internal compiler error |
| 5 | clang or the linker failed |

How arguments are parsed

- An option matches exactly (`-g`), as `--option=value`, or with the value attached (`-O2`, `-Wno-TKO0201`).
- An optional value must be attached with `=`: `--dump-tokens=pp`.
- `--` ends option parsing; everything after it is an input file.
- Inputs are classified by extension: `.o` is an object, `.rc` is a resource script, anything else is source.
- A `#cmdline "..."` line in the first source file restarts the compile with those options, and the source wins over the command line.


## Subcommands {#app-cli-subcommands}

A subcommand is the first word on the command line. It builds a project from its `tiko.toml`, as Chapter 31 shows; every other command line is the compiler driver described by the rest of this appendix.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `tiko build` | build the targets of tiko.toml, or the roots given -- cached |
| `tiko clean` | remove what 'tiko build' would write |
| `tiko metadata` | print the project as JSON: targets, profiles, modules |
| `tiko run` | build one exe target, then run it with the arguments after -- |
| `tiko check` | every diagnostic a build would give, through lowering; nothing written |
| `tiko c2t` | translate a C header into a tiko header: tiko c2t <in.h> [-o <out.ti>\|-] |

## General {#app-cli-general}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--help[=‹category›]` | show help; optionally for one category |
| `--version` | show version and exit |
| `-v` | echo every tool invocation |
| `-restart` | accepted and ignored; a '#cmdline' restarts by itself |
| `--print-graph` | print the modules the inputs import, in build order, and stop |
| `--emit-tki` | print the interface of the module directory given, and stop |
| `--frontend-only` | report every diagnostic a build would, through lowering; write no object, link nothing ('tiko check') |
| `--no-module-cache` | build imported modules without reading or writing the module cache |
| `--clean-module-cache` | empty the module cache and stop |
| `-z ‹option›` | fbc extended option; accepted and ignored |
| `-maxinstdepth ‹n›` | how deep one generic instantiation may drive another (default 64) |

## Input {#app-cli-input}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-i ‹dir›` | add an include search path |
| `--pkg-dir ‹dir›` | the package tree for #import std/... is found in (else TIKO_PKG, else <exe-dir>/pkg) |
| `-d ‹name=val›` | define a preprocessor symbol |
| `-p ‹dir›` | add a library search path |
| `-l ‹name›` | link against a library |

## Output {#app-cli-output}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-Wl ‹a,b,c›` | pass options to the linker, split at commas, as fbc's -Wl |
| `-norpath` | no $ORIGIN run path when a Linux link takes a shared library |
| `-nocopylibs` | do not copy vendor libraries or modules' runtime files beside the output |
| `-o ‹file›` | output path |
| `-x ‹file›` | the linked output's path, as fbc's -x: over -o, the last one winning; ignored with -c |
| `-c` | compile only; do not link |
| `-dll` | build a DLL rather than an executable |
| `-dylib` | same as -dll |
| `-lib` | build a static library |
| `-e` | enable runtime error checking |
| `-ex` | as -e: RESUME, which fbc adds here, does not exist in the fb dialect |
| `-exx` | -ex plus array bounds and null-pointer checking |
| `-g` | emit debug information |
| `-earray` | check array bounds (one part of -exx) |
| `-enullptr` | check pointer dereferences for null (one part of -exx) |
| `-elocation` | record the procedure and module an error happens in (one part of -exx) |
| `-earraydims` | check that an array is dimensioned, and with the rank used (one part of -exx) |
| `-eassert` | enable assert and assertwarn (one part of -g) |
| `-edebug` | define __FB_DEBUG__ as -1 (one part of -g) |
| `-edebuginfo` | emit debug information alone (one part of -g) |
| `-eunwind` | unwind information (one part of -e; always emitted) |
| `-O‹level›` | optimisation level 0-3 |
| `-mt` | link the thread-safe runtime |
| `-pic` | position-independent code, for a Unix shared library (Linux only) |
| `-m ‹name›` | which module owns main; the others become module constructors |

## Target {#app-cli-target}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-target ‹name›` | windows-x86_64 (the Windows default), linux-x86_64 or macos-arm64 |
| `-m64` | 64-bit target (the only supported width) |
| `-m32` | rejected: 32-bit is not supported (x86-64 only) |
| `-s ‹console|gui›` | Windows subsystem of an executable; console is the default |
| `-t ‹kbytes›` | stack reserve and commit of a Windows executable or DLL, in KB (default 2048, minimum 64) |

## Diagnostics {#app-cli-diag}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-Werror` | treat warnings as errors |
| `-Wno-‹id›` | suppress one diagnostic id |
| `-w ‹level›` | fbc's -w: all, pedantic, none, error, or n -- hide fbc's warnings below level n |
| `-fmax-errors ‹n›` | stop after n errors |
| `--color ‹when›` | always, never or auto |
| `--diagnostics-format ‹fmt›` | fbc or gnu |
| `--diagnostics-file ‹path›` | also write every diagnostic to <path> as tab-separated records |
| `--allow-unlowered` | warn (TKO0995) instead of failing when a statement could not be compiled |

## C header import (`#cinclude` and `-cimport`) {#app-cli-cimport}

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-cinclude ‹dir›` | add a C include directory (clang's -I) for #cinclude |
| `-cimport ‹header›` | import a C header as a FreeBASIC binding; needs -cimport-out |
| `-cimport-out ‹file›` | where -cimport writes the binding; - for standard output |
| `-cimport-manifest ‹file›` | write clang's layout of every imported record |
| `-cdefine ‹name[=value]›` | define a C macro (clang's -D) |
| `-csysroot ‹dir›` | the C sysroot (clang's --sysroot) |
| `-copt ‹arg›` | pass an argument to clang verbatim |
| `-cnomacros` | do not import object-like macros as constants |
| `-cnoverify` | do not check tiko's layout of each imported record against clang's |
| `-cnocache` | #cinclude neither reads nor writes the binding cache |
| `-ccachedir ‹dir›` | where #cinclude keeps its bindings (default: the user's cache directory) |
| `--print-cincludes` | import each #cinclude the inputs reach, print where its binding is as JSON, and stop |

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--dump-source` | list loaded source files and stop |
| `--dump-tokens[=‹raw|pp›]` | dump the token stream, before or after the preprocessor |

| `--check` | type expressions; report the type of each PRINT argument |
| `--dump-decisions` | type expressions; list the overload Check chose for each node that implies one |
| `--dump-udt` | print each UDT's size, alignment and field offsets |
| `--cimport-probe ‹header›` | load libclang, parse one C header, print what clang saw |
| `--dump-vtable` | print each UDT's virtual method table |
| `--dump-itable` | print each interface's flattened members (docs/tiko-interfaces) |
| `--dump-rtl` | print the runtime inventory and stop |
| `--parse-expr` | parse each line as one expression and dump it |
| `--parse-only` | parse every input and report counts; the corpus gate |
| `--dump-ir` | dump MIR |
| `--dump-ir-pre-abi` | dump MIR as the frontend made it, before the ABI pass |
| `--verify-selftest` | run the MIR verifier over modules built to fail it |
| `--emit-ir` | write LLVM IR and stop |
| `--emit-asm` | write assembly and stop |
| `--keep-temps` | retain intermediate files |
| `--stats` | report counts and memory use |
| `--time-passes` | report wall time per phase |
| `--build-only-unit ‹n›` | internal to 'tiko build': compile root n alone into the cache, and link nothing |
| `--bootstrap-subset-check` | reject constructs outside the self-hosting subset |
